hold_text: Edits scripts/research/queue_grade.py, which E58 lists as landing machinery (its --verify vouches the grade PRs that self-land), so R12 holds it for a human. Change: a hand-written cadence:once unit whose EVERY E5 row carries the unit's own decision_rule.id is now graded (grading.attested), and a FAIL closes it (no template confirmatory re-run). Rows from a generic producer rule (RULE-M20-EXIT-LEVER-IS-OOS-GATE, RULE-E7-HARNESS-DISPATCHABLE) or with no rule id leave the unit to a session, as before. Also ml_bakeoff.py: a floor clause over a window with no measured folds (empty holdout) is INDETERMINATE, never FAIL. Tests: queue_grade --self-test, ml_bakeoff --self-test, tests/test_research_queue_autonomy.py + grader/harness/queue suites (129 passed).
why: RESEARCH-GRADE-BACKLOG: 140 queued hand-written units had results and no step of the loop closed them; this makes the grade cron close the 130 whose rows attest their own rule.
